query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.nameJa, c.imageUrl, ds.sourceUrl, ds.lastFetchStatus
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN dataSources ds ON c.id = ds.cardId
WHERE c.name != 'Unknown Card' AND c.name IS NOT NULL AND c.name != ''
LIMIT 5;
